configuration.film_support_collision_method: exact cuboid mesh with convex-element narrow phase
configuration.reason: Implicit elastic membrane replaces a constrained-edge trial with a 44% transient strain. Exact cuboid meshes preserve tube geometry while using convex-element collision detection. Film/solid intersections beyond 0.1 mm are rejected independently.
